text: Extracted and read twelve operator-supplied docx documents (two were exact duplicates - the Verification Card was supplied twice under different upload names). Together they form a complete prior six-stage investigation: Evidence Register (51 entries), Analysis Register (15 paths), Lattice Atlas (4 load-bearing nodes, 2 stress points, 3 structured absences, 3 emergent patterns), Temporal Projection Integrity Engine (4 observations advancing, 2 excluded), Enforcement Notice (5 structural findings, 4 remedy demands), and an advocacy package (formal notice to Council, MP letter, GIPA application, recipient guide, verification card, press release).

Parsed the 51-entry Evidence Register programmatically (ER-001 through ER-051) into this repository's EV- schema, mapping 1:1 by number. Preserved each entry's original classification and Factual Strength score as context, but assigned this repository's own uniform "Requires Verification"/"Unverified" status throughout, since nothing has been independently re-fetched by this repository - see DEC-0001.

Found a real inconsistency between the press release and MP letter (both describing the formal notice and GIPA application as already sent) and the recipient guide plus the documents' own unsigned-template state (instructing sending as a Step 1 future action). Logged as CTR-0002 and Q-0005 rather than silently treating either account as settled - see DEC-0002.

Independently re-fetched the actual Crown Lands Administration of Crown Roads Policy IND-O-250 PDF (the case's single most load-bearing document, underlying Structural Finding 4 and the Eligibility Loop mechanism) and confirmed the exact quoted text on all three claims cited from it: the maintenance-triggers-transfer-eligibility criterion, the pre-emptive exclusion of road condition and financial implications as valid refusal grounds, and the statement that the department does not provide road maintenance services. EV-0037, EV-0039, EV-0040 upgraded to Verified on this basis - the only items in this case independently confirmed by this repository rather than carried over from the original register. A second attempt to independently confirm the Roads Act 1993 s.7/s.108 Crown-roads-authority provision failed - both austlii.edu.au and legislation.nsw.gov.au returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch. That claim remains Requires Verification.

Added Yield Catalogue framing to this case's Enforcement Notice (before any recipient or remedy demand) and Advocacy Package (naming its own components - Evidence Register, Five-Step Verification, non-allegatory framing - as Citizen Tools already delivered, independent of enforcement outcome). Applied identically across every case with a built Enforcement Notice, per the operator's instruction to apply the Yield Catalogue everywhere rather than to a single case. See DEC-0003.
